# Common Questions Answered

**How quickly can you repair storm damage?**
Triple G Roofing offers same-day inspections for storm damage and works directly with insurance adjusters. Most repairs begin within 48 hours of approval. During severe weather season, emergency crews are on standby for Huffman-area homeowners.

**What roof materials work best in Huffman's climate?**
Impact-resistant shingles, architectural asphalt, and metal roofing all perform well in the hot, humid Texas Gulf Coast climate with frequent hail and wind exposure. We assess each home's specific exposure, budget, and aesthetic preferences to recommend the best option.

**Do you handle insurance claims?**
Yes. We provide detailed estimates that meet insurance requirements, communicate directly with adjusters, and bill insurance companies whenever possible — so homeowners avoid out-of-pocket expenses.

**What warranty comes with a new roof?**
Triple G Roofing guarantees 10 years of workmanship on all installations. Shingles carry manufacturer warranties of 25-30 years. As an authorized installer, warranties remain valid even after the job is complete.

**How often should I inspect my roof?**
Annual inspections are recommended, plus an extra inspection after any major North Harris County storm. Many insurance claims are denied because damage wasn't documented quickly. Prompt inspection protects both the roof and the homeowner's ability to file a valid claim.

# Insurance & Claims
Triple G Roofing builds claim-ready inspection reports, meets adjusters on-site, and communicates directly with insurance companies. We document storm damage with photos, support homeowners through the claims process, and bill insurers directly whenever possible to reduce upfront costs.
